defs.def: to have sth on your body as a piece of clothing, a decoration, etc. 穿；戴；佩戴

ex.s: Wear a team uniform.
ex.t: 穿团队制服。

ex.s: Wear proper clothes.
ex.t: 穿合适的衣服。

ex.s: The uncertainty was starting to wear on us, so I wanted to do something special.
ex.t: 这种不确定性开始让我们感到压力所以我想做点特别的事情。

ex.s: Baggy wears a pollution monitor on her collar so she can take data measurements close to the ground.
ex.t: 巴吉的衣领上戴着一个污染监测器，这样她就能在贴近地面的地方采集数据。

ex.s: Pupils at about 90 percent of British secondary schools wear uniforms.
ex.t: 约90%的英国中学生就读的学校要求学生穿校服。

ex.s: Wear warm clothes.
ex.t: 穿暖和的衣服。

ex.s: So if moving the body can have these effects, what about the clothes we wear?
ex.t: 所以，如果移动身体能有这些效果，那我们穿的衣服呢？

ex.s: Is the writer who wears a fedora more creative?
ex.t: 戴软呢帽的作家就更有创造力吗？

ex.s: What are the students allowed to wear in the lab ?
ex.t: 允许学生在实验室穿什么衣服？

ex.s: It also has a voice control setting that enables you to stay hands-free, while its waterproof band is fully adjustable so that it is comfortable to wear.
ex.t: 它还带有语音控制设置，让你无需动手，而其防水的表带可完全调节，佩戴舒适。

ex.s: Wear clothes that can get dirty.
ex.t: 请穿不怕弄脏的衣服。

ex.s: It's celebrated for… on… You can wear… You can… if you like.
ex.t: 它的庆祝……在……你可以穿……你还可以……如果你喜欢的话。

ex.s: Above all, I hoped he wouldn't assign me to work with the fiercely competitive, extremely serious fellow who always wore dark clothes and apparently had a personality to match.
ex.t: 最重要的是，我希望他不会把我分配给那个竞争心极强、极其严肃、总是穿深色衣服、而且显然性格也与之相称的家伙。

ex.s: But in half the cases she wore a specially designed fat suit which increased her weight to 180 pounds.
ex.t: 但在一半的情境下，她穿了一件特制的肥胖装，使体重增至180磅。

ex.s: What can we infer abouf wearing fur in New York according to Morgan?
ex.t: 根据摩根的说法，关于在纽约穿皮草能推断出什么？

ex.s: To oppose wearing fur coats.
ex.t: 反对穿皮草外套。

ex.s: Adam and Galinsky tested the effect of simply wearing a white lab coat on people’s powers of attention.
ex.t: Adam和Galinsky测试了仅仅穿上白大褂对人注意力的影响。

ex.s: Indeed, they made only half as many errors as those wearing their own clothes on the Stroop Test( one way of measuring attention).
ex.t: 事实上，他们在斯特鲁普测试（一种测量注意力的方法）中犯的错误只有穿自己衣服者的一半。

ex.s: Is the psychologist wearing little round glasses and smoking a cigar more insightful?
ex.t: 那位戴着小圆眼镜、抽着雪茄的心理学家是否更有洞察力？

ex.s: Remember to wear comfortable walking shoes.
ex.t: 记得穿舒适的步行鞋。

ex.s: More recently, the foundation began another  47  called National Red Scarf Day --- a day when people donate $20 and wear red scarves in support of Canada’s  48   and homeless.
ex.t: 最近，该基金会又发起了一项名为“全国红围巾日”的活动——这一天人们捐出20美元并戴上红围巾，以支持加拿大的____和无家可归者。

defs.def: to have your hair in a particular style; to have a beard or moustache 蓄，留（发、须等）

ex.s: People doing different jobs should wear different clothes
ex.t: 从事不同工作的人应该穿不同的衣服

defs.def: to have a particular expression on your face 流露，面带，呈现（某种神态）
to become, or make sth become thinner, smoother or weaker through continuous use or rubbing 磨损；消耗；用旧

ex.s: What's more, reconstructions might be the only way to know what treasures looked like before time wore them down.
ex.t: 更重要的是，重建可能是了解这些珍宝在岁月侵蚀之前是什么样子的唯一方法。

ex.s: Funny complaints can wear people out.
ex.t: 有趣的抱怨会让人疲惫。

defs.def: to make a hole, path, etc. in sth by continuous use or rubbing 穿破；磨出（洞）；踩出（路）；冲出（沟）
to stay in good condition after being used for a long time 耐用；耐穿；耐磨；耐久
to accept or allow sth, especially sth that you do not approve of 通常用于问句和否定句

ex.s: But I usually wear my hair in a ponytail these days as it has got a lot longer.
ex.t: 不过这些天我通常把头发扎成马尾，因为头发长长了很多。

defs.def: the fact of wearing sth 衣着；穿着；穿戴；佩戴

ex.s: What they found was that people wearing white coats performed better than those who weren’t.
ex.t: 人们的穿着会影响他们的感受

ex.s: Most of them wore clothes that were torn and dirty.
ex.t: 大多数人穿着破旧脏污的衣服。

ex.s: What people wear can affect their cognitive performance
ex.t: 由于再加工过程中几乎3%的金属会损失，我们每年需要额外制作10个罐头。

ex.s: From now on I will only be editing articles for PsyBlog while wearing a white coat to help keep the typing error count low.
ex.t: 从现在起，我只会在穿着白大褂的情况下编辑PsyBlog的文章，以帮助减少打字错误的数量。

ex.s: She can be seen worn/wearing mermaid clothing and dived/diving up to 50 feet underwater to swim with dolphins, sharks and whales.
ex.t: 可以看到她穿着/穿着美人鱼服装，在水下50英尺深处潜水/潜水，与海豚、鲨鱼和鲸鱼一起游泳。

defs.def: the amount or type of use that sth has over a period of time 使用量（或形式）；耐用性；经久性

ex.s: Morgan says，”To give people a guilt-free option that they can wear without someone throwing paint on them-1 think that’s going to be a massive thing, at least here in New York.” Designer Jennifer Anderson admits it took her a while to come around to the opinion that using nutria fur for her creations is morally acceptable.
ex.t: 摩根说：“给人们一种毫无愧疚感的选择，让他们穿上也不会被人泼油漆——我认为这会是一件大事，至少在纽约这里。”设计师詹妮弗·安德森承认，她花了一段时间才接受在其创作中使用海狸鼠毛皮在道德上可以接受的观点。

defs.def: the damage or loss of quality that is caused when sth has been used a lot （因使用过度而）磨损；用坏；耗损

chunks.en: wear white / like / warm / team / own / proper / clothes / uniforms / little
chunks.cn: 穿白色 / 穿 / 穿温暖的 / 穿团队 / 穿自己的 / 穿符合习俗的 / 穿衣服 / 穿制服 / 穿小的
